The expression $\left(x^{2} + 8\right)^{2}$ can be written as $\left(x^{2} + 8\right)\left(x^{2} + 8\right)$, which is equivalent to $x^{2}\left(x^{2} + 8\right) + 8\left(x^{2} + 8\right)$. Distributing yields $x^{4} + 8x^{2} + 8x^{2} + 64$, or $x^{4} + 16x^{2} + 64$. The expression $\left(x - 3\right)\left(x + 3\right)$ is equivalent to $x^{2} + 3x - 3x - 9$, or $x^{2} - 9$. Therefore, $\left(x^{2} + 8\right)^{2} + \left(x - 3\right)\left(x + 3\right)$ is equivalent to $\left(x^{4} + 16x^{2} + 64\right) + \left(x^{2} - 9\right)$. Combining like terms yields $x^{4} + 17x^{2} + 55$.
